name: cortex-flash-a100
readme: Cortex Flash: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Unsloth GGUF) served by llama-server on 2x A100 80GB. Placeholders to edit on import: imageName (build hosting/Dockerfile.cortex and push, or point at a public mirror), env.HF_TOKEN. See hosting/README.md and docs/GPU-TEST-PLAN.md. Single A100-80GB cannot fit the model: UD-IQ1_M needs ~140 GB resident; UD-IQ1_S ~128 GB. Two GPUs are required.
